Hi Jordan / Priya / Marissa —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. I filled in answers inline in the spreadsheet (returning it via the shared attachment) and summarized the key items below to make it easier for procurement/security triage.

SOC 2
- Status: SOC 2 Type II (covering security, availability, confidentiality) completed March 2026.
- Report access: Available under NDA; we can provide a secure access link once NDA is in place.

GDPR / HIPAA
- GDPR: Redwood acts as a processor when customers send data to our hosted API. We offer a standard DPA that meets EU SCCs and can incorporate customer-specific clauses where needed.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workloads on Dedicated and Private deployments; Hosted API can be configured for BAAs in specific customer engagements. We’ll need to engage legal/procurement during contracting.

Data retention & deletion (primary data)
- Default behavior: Customer-controlled data (customer prompts, content, embeddings) is retained for X days in the hosted service by default (we typically configure 30 days for trial/prod depending on contract).
- Deletion SLA for primary data: We commit to purging primary customer data from active store within 30 days of a validated deletion request in hosted plans. For Dedicated/Private deployments we can contract to tighter SLAs and provide operational confirmation.

Backups & immutable copies
- Backups: Standard backup retention windows are longer and are treated as immutable snapshots. Our default backup retention is 180 days. Because backups are incremental and periodically rebuilt, deletion is handled at snapshot-expiration time rather than instant wipe.
- Backup deletion SLA: We can commit to backup expiration within a contractual window; however, immediate removal from immutable backups is not guaranteed for hosted shared environments. For Dedicated and Private deployments, we can negotiate shorter backup retention and specific processes to remove data from backups where required.

Log retention
- Default log retention: 180 days for audit and request logs in hosted plans.
- Options: We can shorten log retention to 90 or 30 days by contract for Dedicated/Private customers, and offer scoped log access controls.

Encryption / key management
- Encryption at rest: All customer data encrypted at rest. Hosted customers use Redwood-managed KMS by default.
- Customer-managed keys: Available for Dedicated and Private deployments (bring-your-own-KMS) to meet stricter compliance requirements.

Next steps / asks
1) I attached a draft Data_Retention_SLA_Draft.docx with suggested language for deletion SLAs and backups. Please review and flag any required edits (Priya/legal).
2) We uploaded a redacted SOC 2 summary to a secure location — full report available after NDA.
3) If you agree, let’s schedule a 30-minute call early next week to walk through the questionnaire answers and finalize DPA/DPA language.

If you need any technical detail (how backups are snapshot/retention-managed, KV cache lifecycles, etc.), Rishi can jump in on the call.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
